load_path: LevelDataInitializer reads levelData.plist into Core Data (ChapterMO/LevelMO)
Play uses LevelMO.dataFile -> bundle path LevelXML/%@ (or LevelXML/hd/%@ on HD)

format.container: plain UTF-8 LevelXML (not encrypted, not plist-wrapped)
format.bool_style: t/f in campaign levels (Flash-compatible); user_level_example uses 0/1
format.coordinate_scale: pixel space ~thousands (same as modern Flash editor), NOT the /40 iOS-share encoding
format.slow_motion_panel: type 5001 / SLOWMOTIONPANEL exists in binary but NOT used in any bundled campaign LevelXML
